notes:
Dahu 0.99.0 beta for Windows.

- Selected surfaces are tinted in Shaded and Ghosted, with or without edges. Whole objects and selected faces share the existing Selection colour preference; picked edges remain distinct and their parent stays neutral.
- The title bar shows explicit Unsaved changes / Saving… feedback. Healthy recovery runs quietly; recovery failures remain visible.
- Tool startup keeps reference paragraphs out of the command transcript. Drawing tools show the next point to pick instead of generic control instructions; full descriptions remain in Command reference.
- The inline command strip starts fresh on New, successful Open and application restart. F2 retains recent local history grouped by document and session. Up/Down command recall is preserved; Save As updates the section name without resetting it.
- Command history stays on this computer and is not included in shared .dahu project files.
